# <span class="en">Reproducibility appendix</span><span class="zh">可复现性附录</span> {#sec-repro}

## <span class="en">How to reproduce this report</span><span class="zh">如何复现本报告</span>

::: {.en}
The exercise is a self-contained folder inside the course's Quarto website.
Every path in the scripts and in the report is relative to
`take-home-ex/take-home-ex2/`, and the scripts are run from there:
:::

::: {.zh}
本作业是课程 Quarto 网站中一个自包含的文件夹。脚本与报告中的每一个路径都相对于
`take-home-ex/take-home-ex2/`,脚本也从这里运行:
:::

```bash
# 0. Place the ACLED extract (from eLearn) anywhere under data/raw/
#    e.g. data/raw/acled/ACLED_Data_Myanmar_Jan2021-Sep2025.csv

# 1. Preparation
Rscript scripts/01_boundaries.R   # MIMU townships, CRS choice, neighbours
Rscript scripts/02_acled.R        # ACLED audit, geocoding, panels

# 2. Analysis
Rscript scripts/03_lmsa.R         # global and local Moran's I, Gi*, sensitivity
Rscript scripts/04_ehsa.R         # space-time cube, EHSA, sfdep check, null
Rscript scripts/05_markov.R       # value-added: spatial Markov, FE logit, onsets

# 3. Render, from the site root
quarto render take-home-ex/take-home-ex2/take-home-ex2.qmd
quarto render take-home-ex/take-home-ex2/take-home-ex2-slides.qmd
```

::: {.callout-note .en}
## Data that are and are not in the repository
**ACLED's terms of use do not allow the event records to be republished**, so
the extract itself and the event-level objects built from it
(`events_sf.rds`, `conflict_sf.rds`) are kept out of the repository. Everything
the report reads is aggregated to the township: the panels, the totals, the
audit tables and the analysis results in `data/derived/`, which are
committed, so the report renders from a clean clone without the raw data.
To re-run the scripts, the ACLED extract has to be obtained from the course
or from ACLED directly. The MIMU v9.4 boundary archive is committed, because
MIMU replaces its releases and this version may not stay available.
:::

::: {.callout-note .zh}
## 仓库中包含与不包含的数据
**ACLED 的使用条款不允许重新发布事件记录**,因此数据摘录本身,以及由其构建的事件级
对象(`events_sf.rds`、`conflict_sf.rds`)都不放入仓库。报告读取的一切都已汇总到
镇区:`data/derived/` 中的面板、总量、审计表与分析结果都已提交,因此从一份干净的
克隆出发,无需原始数据即可渲染报告。若要重新运行脚本,需要从课程或直接从 ACLED 获取
数据摘录。MIMU v9.4 边界压缩包已提交,因为 MIMU 会替换其发布版本,该版本未必会一直
可供下载。
:::

## <span class="en">Pipeline structure</span><span class="zh">管线结构</span>

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-pipeline
flowchart TD
  M(["MIMU v9.4 zip<br/>data/raw/"]) --> S1["01_boundaries.R<br/><i>CRS, islands, neighbours</i>"]
  A(["ACLED extract<br/>(not committed)"]) --> S2["02_acled.R<br/><i>audit, join, screening</i>"]
  S1 --> D1(["township_an · nb_an · nb_knn6"])
  D1 --> S2
  S2 --> D2(["panel_q · panel_m · panel_y<br/>ts_tot · acled_audit"])
  D1 --> S3["03_lmsa.R<br/><i>Moran, LISA, Gi*</i>"]
  D2 --> S3
  D1 --> S4["04_ehsa.R<br/><i>cube, EHSA, sfdep check, null</i>"]
  D2 --> S4
  U["R/utils.R · R/ehsa.R"] --> S3
  U --> S4
  D1 --> S5["05_markov.R<br/><i>Markov, FE logit, onsets</i>"]
  D2 --> S5
  S3 --> R(["take-home-ex2.qmd<br/>take-home-ex2-slides.qmd"])
  S4 --> R
  S5 --> R
```

## <span class="en">Caching and seeds</span><span class="zh">缓存与随机种子</span>

::: {.en}
The permutation tests are the slow part. Each expensive result is computed
through `cache_rds()` in `R/utils.R`, which stores it in `data/cache/` and
returns the stored object on later runs. Every script sets `set.seed(1234)`,
and functions that draw permutations set their own seed, so deleting
`data/cache/` and re-running reproduces the same values. A full run from a
cold cache takes about 20 minutes, most of it in `04_ehsa.R`.
:::

::: {.zh}
置换检验是耗时的部分。每个耗时结果都通过 `R/utils.R` 中的 `cache_rds()` 计算,它把
结果存入 `data/cache/`,并在之后的运行中直接返回存储的对象。每个脚本都设定了
`set.seed(1234)`,抽取置换的函数也会设定自己的种子,因此删除 `data/cache/` 后重新运行,
得到的数值完全相同。从空缓存完整运行一次约需 20 分钟,大部分时间花在 `04_ehsa.R` 上。
:::

## <span class="en">Session information</span><span class="zh">会话信息</span>

```{r}
#| label: sessioninfo
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Full session information"

si <- sessionInfo()
pkgs <- c("sf", "spdep", "sfdep", "Kendall", "dplyr", "tidyr", "purrr",
          "ggplot2", "patchwork", "scales", "ggrepel", "gt", "lubridate",
          "readr", "sandwich", "lmtest", "knitr", "rmarkdown")
tibble::tibble(
  Package = pkgs,
  Version = vapply(pkgs, function(p)
    tryCatch(as.character(utils::packageVersion(p)),
             error = function(e) "not installed"), character(1))
) |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::tab_header(title = gt::md(paste0("**", si$R.version$version.string, "** on ",
                                       si$running))) |>
  gt::tab_source_note(gt::md(paste0(
    "GEOS ", sf::sf_extSoftVersion()[["GEOS"]],
    " &middot; GDAL ", sf::sf_extSoftVersion()[["GDAL"]],
    " &middot; PROJ ", sf::sf_extSoftVersion()[["PROJ"]]))) |>
  gt::tab_options(table.font.size = gt::pct(82), data_row.padding = gt::px(3))
```
